expl: Coal is mainly a mixture of free carbon and carbon compounds. Through the chemical process of carbonization, plant material gets converted into coal. Coal is mainly of four types— Anthracite, Bituminous, Sub-bituminous, and Lignite. Among these four types, bituminous coal is considered the common variety. Anthracite is the best quality coal. In India, about 99 percent of the total coal found occurs in ancient Gondwana rocks. Gondwana-age coal is mainly of the bituminous type.

stem: Which of the following countries is the leading country in the reserve of hard Coal?
expl: At the time of the question, option (b) was the correct answer. According to 2023 data, the United States of America ranks first in hard coal reserves, followed by China and India.

stem: Which of the following countries has the largest reserve of coal deposits?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: The largest proven reserves of coal (in 2023) are held by the United States of America. After this, Russia, China, Australia, and India have the highest coal reserves, respectively. It may be noted that, at the global level, India ranks 5th in proven coal reserves. According to World Mineral Production 2019–2023, in 2023 the leading coal-producing countries are, respectively, China, India, Indonesia, and the United States of America.

stem: The highest coal-producing country in the world is-
expl: According to World Mineral Production 2019–2023, China ranked first in coal production in 2023.

stem: Which one of the following is not a coal region of Germany?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Ruhr Valley, Saar Basin, and Aachen Basin are coalfields of Germany, whereas the Lorraine Basin is mainly a coalfield of France.

stem: in which country is the world-famous iron ore deposit called Krivoy rog located?
expl: The world-famous iron ore deposit region called Krivoy Rog is located in Ukraine. Iron ore was discovered in this region in the 18th century.

stem: Which of the following is an iron ore ?
expl: Among the given options, limonite is an iron ore. Its chemical formula is FeO(OH).nHO. Magnetite, hematite, siderite etc. are other major iron ores. Among the other options, cinnabar is an ore of mercury, while bauxite is an ore of aluminium. Pyrite or iron pyrite (chemical formula FeS) also contains iron, but this sulphide mineral is used commercially mainly for producing sulphur dioxide and sulphuric acid, and it is generally not used as an iron ore.

stem: The ‘rust Bowl’ of the United States is related to which of the following regions?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Rust Bowl or Rust Belt is an iron-producing economic region of the United States in the Northeastern and Midwestern parts. It includes areas such as Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania, etc. It also includes the Great Lakes region and the Pittsburgh region, etc. Therefore, option (e) is the correct answer.

stem: Which of the following minerals occurs in the Minas Gerais province of Brazil ?
expl: Minas Gerais is a state (estado) located in the southeastern region of Brazil. It is mainly known for its high-grade iron ore deposits. Besides this, bauxite, manganese, tin, gold, zinc, etc. are also mined here. Minas Gerais is also famous for the production of precious and semi-precious gemstones.

stem: Which of the following countries produced the highest annual gold production (in tonnes) in 2019?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: In the question period, and even at present, China is the top producer of gold. According to the data up to the year 2023 in World Mineral Production 2019–2023, the top four gold-producing countries respectively are: China, Russia, Australia and Canada.

stem: Which of the following activities is performed at Coolgardie?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Coolgardie, located in Western Australia, is famous for gold mining. At present, it is also popular among tourists as a “Mining Ghost Town.”
Johannesburg is the capital of Gauteng Province of South Africa. It is world-famous for gold mining.

stem:
Assertion : rich placer deposits of gold are found on the coast of Ghana and gold veins are found in Brazil. reason ( r ) : At one time these continents were joined together along the Atlantic coast.
Choose the correct answer.

options.label: a
options.text: Both (A) and ( R ) are correct and ( R ) is the correct explanation of ( A )

options.label: b
options.text: Both (A) and ( R ) are correct; but ( R ) is not the correct explanation of (A)

options.label: c
options.text: ( A ) is wrong but ( R ) is correct

expl: Ghana is a country in West Africa, located on the coast of the Gulf of Guinea. Rich placer deposits of gold are found on the Ghana coast and gold veins are found in Brazil. According to geology, this is because at one time these continents were joined together along the Atlantic coast. Therefore, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

stem: The largest producer of aluminium in the world is –
expl: During the period of the question, among the given options, India was the leading producer of primary aluminium. According to world mineral production 2019-2023 data for the year 2023, the top five producers of primary aluminium in the world were— 1. China, 2. Russia, 3. India, 4. Canada, 5. U.A.E.

stem: Which one among the following countries of the world, except the United States of America, is the largest crude oil producer?

expl: According to the World Minerals Production 2019-2023 in the year 2023, after the USA, Russia and Saudi Arabia were the largest producers of crude oil, respectively.

expl: According to the 59th OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin, 2024, in the year 2023, the largest proved reserves of crude oil were in Venezuela, amounting to 303,008 million barrels. Venezuela possessed about 19.31% of the world’s total crude oil reserves.
